description: Parameters needed to the corresponding task specification in eTaSL

from-force_control_task_lib-version-0.1..description:
Library force_control_task_lib version 0.1.0.
 Set to true to indicate that task specification comes from the library above. 
 Library description: Library with eTaSL task specifications for force control tasks for Crospi
Authors: Santiago Iregui (KU Leuven), Erwin Aertbeliën (KU Leuven), Federico Ulloa (KU Leuven)

file_path.description: File path of the corresponding task specification

parameters.description: List of parameters needed to define an instance of the task specification

FT_sensor_frame.description:
Name of frame where the forces and torques are measured. 
Set as a string beginning with $blackboard such as `$blackboard/output_param/my_task/my_param` if the value is not yet known and thus will be set externally at runtime (only once) depending on e.g. the outcome of a previous action or the outcome of another module.
Set as $application_defined_parameter to indicate that the parameter is defined by the application and not by the skill specification.

is-2D_contour_following.description:
Task Specification: 2D_contour_following.etasl.lua
Set to true to indicate that the task uses the task specification mentioned above. 
 Task description: This task specification implements 2D contour following with the task frame formalism: force control along the normal of the contour, velocity control along its tangent, and constant height and orientation of the tool. The task frame rotates around the tool axis to track the normal of the contour, estimated from the measured contact force. The robot must already be in contact with the contour when the task starts. The task finishes after travelling the specified path length.
